_comment: "**Action** - {r}{r}{r}, {t}: Sharpen target sword you control. Go again." The sharpen was a GAIN of a keyword named SHARPEN (sharpen is an EFFECT, not a keyword -- that only appended a string to combat.keywords) or a bare MODIFY_ATTACK. The cost was also wrong in both directions: it charged an invented PITCH of a hand card and never tapped, while the printed cost is {r}{r}{r} plus {t}.
